Two additional brass weights sit on a black-topped table at the lower right. A wooden radiator grille runs along the lower wall. The camera is fixed and the background does not shift.
visible_changes: The man's raised right arm and hand continually reposition while gesturing: in the early frames the open palm hovers close to the equation on the left of the board, and in the later frames the arm extends further right with the index finger pointing toward the suspended tape / center of the board.
The man's torso and head turn slightly over time, revealing more of his face in profile in the later frames than in the early ones; his lowered left arm also shifts a little with his body.

The suspended apparatus (tape with weight, vertical ruler, right rod with weight) and the weights on the table remain in the same positions throughout the sampled frames; no motion of these objects is visible within the excerpt.
